title: Leverage topic
description: The `leverage/<sourceId>/<instrumentId>` topic (decision 0007 part 3 decision 8; roadmap P3): the account's leverage, margin mode and margin available on one perpetual, from Hyperliquid's `activeAssetData` (leverage-frame.schema.json) with the catalogue's maximum leverage and whether only isolated margin is offered. Served by src/runtime/account/topics.ts; mirrors src/panel/model/form.ts (LeverageState). `availableToTrade` is the venue's pair as sent: the panel reads the first as buy and the second as sell, which pin P6 of decision 0003a still has to confirm. Never a JSON number.
